name: robinhood-trading
description: Unofficial. Six skills for Robinhood's agentic-trading MCP: checked order tickets, cross-account wash-sale checks, exit protection with native alerts, an options monitor (exits, expiration, assignment), an agent report card and a config-driven options screener. Simulates orders by default; a fail-closed PreToolUse hook blocks placement, and opt-in confirm mode asks you to approve each reviewed order. Not affiliated with Robinhood Markets, Inc.

audit_log.title: Local audit log
audit_log.description: Append each Robinhood tool call (account numbers masked, responses summarized) to a hash-chained JSONL file under ~/.local/state/robinhood-skills/audit. Local only; never uploaded. Turning it off also makes confirm mode unavailable, because the confirm gate needs the review ledger.

guard_exempt_servers.title: Order-guard exempt MCP servers
guard_exempt_servers.description: Comma-separated MCP server names whose place_/exercise_/replace_ tools the guard should ignore (for example another broker's server you manage yourself). Servers that have served a known Robinhood tool are never exempt. Leave empty unless you know you need it.

order_mode.title: Order mode
order_mode.description: simulate_only (default): every place_* call is blocked. confirm: the agent may call place_* only for the exact order you reviewed and approved in chat, and you approve each live order in a permission prompt. exercise_option stays blocked. Interactive sessions only. Confirm mode also needs max_order_notional_usd and the local audit log.

max_order_notional_usd.title: Max notional per live order (USD)
max_order_notional_usd.description: Required for confirm mode. Live orders whose computed notional exceeds this, or can't be computed, are denied. Example: 500.00

review_ttl_seconds.title: Review freshness (seconds)
review_ttl_seconds.description: Confirm mode only. A place_* call must match a review from this session no older than this. Allowed 60-900.
